description: Material changes since a checkpoint: each with its filing, filing date, a check against the lender's own rows, NEW_EVENT or NEWLY_OBSERVED_HISTORICAL, a materiality score with its rubric, and duplicates folded. Returns the next checkpoint; a repeated call returns the same delivery.

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint id the previous answer returned; omit for the latest.

include_historical.description: Also show filings older than the checkpoint that were ingested since.

watch_id.description: A watch id from watch creation.
